To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the Canadian press, in general, is not doing a good job in covering foreign affairs, and that this situation is unlikely to change unless there are major shifts in the political and economic climate, or in the way that journalists are trained and rewarded.

the Canadian press has not lived up to the expectations of those who believe that it should play a major role in the foreign‐policy process, and that it is not likely to do so in the foreseeable future.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how the press performs its role as the public’s watchdog on government and its ability to inform and shape public opinion and policy.
the role of the media in Canadian foreign policy, and the role of Canadian foreign policy in the media.
the relationship between the press and foreign policy.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

there has been a substantial decline in foreign news coverage, a shift in emphasis from the rest of the globe to Canada-US relations and, in the case of the English‐language press, an increased reliance on Canadian sources.
the coverage is still not good, that it has improved somewhat, that it has declined in some areas, and that it is not likely to improve much unless the media are forced to improve it.
the Canadian press is a very good press for Canadian foreign policy.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the press has become more of a mirror than a window, more a reflection than a source of Canadian foreign policy.
the Canadian media are not fulfilling the role that they might and should in a democracy.
there is a continuing need for a more critical and informed Canadian press coverage of Canadian foreign affairs.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the press is an important actor in foreign policy.
the media is not the most important source of information about foreign policy.
there is a clear need for a Canadian foreign policy community to take a more active role in promoting the study and analysis of foreign policy and international affairs in the country.
